question.text: The PEG ratio adjusts P/E for:

explanation.text: The Logic: PEG = P/E divided by earnings growth (%); normalises valuation for growth. The Trap: Other adjustments use different ratios. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: PEG near 1 = fair; <1 undervalued; >1 overvalued (with caveats).
